rv.q: The S Paradox delivers thrill after thrill, tightly choreographed combat, multiple dimensions, and snappy, character-driven dialogue that keeps you invested in the story.
THE S PARADOX blew my socks off!
It is a mind-blowing delight that blends time travel, good versus evil, and thrilling fights.

cn.t: Critics praise this time-travel sci-fi thriller for its smart script, impeccable stage combat, and strong female focus, with most calling it an innovative triumph despite some pacing concerns in the second half.
